completion_rule: A and B may only be marked complete when every suite has executable scenario contracts and the corresponding receipts pass.

suites.name: Orders
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
document/架構重整/01_規格基線/15_正式規格索引與裁決總表.md
acceptance: Terms and commands are roots; derived order state is never seeded.
Lifecycle transitions, stale versions and replay have independent expected answers.
State-machine harnesses may provide an authoritative read snapshot but never pre-create their output event, receipt or projection.
Typed query/UI harnesses validate declared views and zero mutation without being business-data fixtures.
Typed API and UI views expose the expected state without mutation.

suites.name: Contract Signing
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
document/架構重整/01_規格基線/21_Contract_Signing_Commitment與正常驗收資料鏈正式規格.md
acceptance: Approved system templates generate immutable case document versions; signed returns are separate archived inputs.
Staff and client signing state is independent from the order lifecycle and cannot be directly seeded.
Deposit settlement may establish the order before customer signing, while execution conversion still requires commitment, customer signing and deposit.
Typed API and UI views expose document version, send, signature, blocker and repair state without mutation.
Replay, stale versions, archive failure and invalid transition preserve formal rows and expose typed errors.

suites.name: Assignments and Scheduling
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Assignments and correction commands are roots; schedule projections are not seeded.
Work-day, hours and end-date conservation are checked across corrections and cancellations.
Lock state-machine harnesses provide read snapshots only and never pre-create their release event or projection.
Conflict, lock, calendar and repair UI states are asserted.

suites.name: Payroll
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Official work facts and policies are roots; salary projections are not seeded.
Payable calculation and double-pay rules have independent expected answers.
Correction and replay preserve the assignment-level audit trail.

suites.name: Client Finance
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Bank roots and typed reconciliation commands are the only payment inputs.
Receipt allocations, lifecycle effects and refunds are projections with independent oracles.
Refund defaults to one exact settlement; partial refund is recovery-only after an underpayment.

suites.name: Staff Payables
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Assignments and outgoing-bank roots drive payable results.
Underpayment, reversal and repair preserve payable truth.
Query and UI values match the expected manifest.

suites.name: Government Subsidy
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Eligibility, work facts and government notices are roots.
Claim, approval and allocation results use independent amount and hour oracles.
Ambiguous or short government receipts remain pending with a visible repair path.

suites.name: Finance Import
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Only source workbook or normalized raw rows are generated.
Fingerprint, direction, classification and reconciliation outputs are not seeded.
Duplicate, invalid and reprocess outcomes are independently asserted.

suites.name: Case Import
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Import payloads and file fixtures are roots.
Normalization, rejection and canonical records have expected manifests.
No invalid source may create a partial business graph.

suites.name: Anomalies
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Anomalies arise from domain roots rather than seeded alert rows.
Each registered code has API and UI recognition assertions.
Claim, owner repair, auto-resolve and reopen are tested where typed recovery exists.

suites.name: LINE
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Webhook and review inputs are roots; task and publication projections are not seeded.
Identity and inbox state machines are independently asserted.
Cross-role LINE identity follows the latest approved field decision.

suites.name: Access Control
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Actor and capability roots produce authorization answers.
Security audit and alert projections are independently checked.
Query and UI access never expose data outside the actor scope.

suites.name: Knowledge
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Source documents and review commands are roots.
Publication, citation and retrieval outputs are not seeded.
Stale, rejected and unsafe content states are visible and non-authoritative.

suites.name: Accounts Payable Export data
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版測試資料規則矩陣_草案.md
acceptance: Payable and refund source views determine export rows.
Aggregation, exclusions and source identifiers have independent expected answers.
Export query does not mutate financial state.

suites.name: Cross-domain business dataflow
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Cross-domain commands preserve money, hours, identity and event invariants.
Partial failure rolls back the complete formal transaction.
API and UI show typed failure rather than false success.

suites.name: Migration and Cutover
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Source is read-only and candidate is disposable.
Drift and unknown partial DDL fail closed.
Journal, recovery and switch receipts are verifiable.

suites.name: Backup Restore Recovery
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Artifacts have content and tool identity digests.
Restore targets are newly created and never overwrite source.
Corruption and recovery failures are explicit typed outcomes.

suites.name: Release Orchestration
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Approval scope, expiry and digest are checked before mutation.
State transitions cannot skip phases.
Restart or smoke failure enters recovery rather than released.

suites.name: Deployment Security and Topology
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Public surfaces and principal boundaries are verified.
Secrets never appear in configuration evidence or logs.
Partial component health cannot report overall release success.

suites.name: Runtime Supervision and Observability
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Readiness, worker heartbeat, lag and dead-letter state are observable.
Structured logs contain correlation but redact sensitive values.
Worker failure cannot be hidden by API-only health.

suites.name: Performance and UX
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: UI loading, stale, error and refresh states have acceptance checks.
Query count, payload and latency are recorded separately from business truth.
A performance budget records evidence only and does not create business alerts.

suites.name: Cache
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Cache keys include identity and fact versions.
Hit, miss and fallback produce identical authorized answers.
Apply commands use fresh reads and do not rely on cache.

suites.name: Durable Jobs
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Duplicate delivery does not duplicate formal commands.
Crash, retry and cancellation states retain typed receipts.
Notification loss never prevents status query.

suites.name: External Side Effects
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Providers are invoked only after the domain commit.
Timeout and acknowledgement crashes do not silently duplicate effects.
Provider failure does not forge a domain success result.

suites.name: Entry Point Governance
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Discovery and governance queue agree on every entry point.
Retired and operator-only entries enforce their stated boundary.
Removed paths cannot be reached by callers.

suites.name: Legacy Writer Retirement
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Final writer scan permits canonical adapters only.
Legacy HTTP paths return typed retirement results where retained.
New commands do not mutate legacy tables.

suites.name: Archive Retention Capacity
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Archives are atomically published at immutable paths.
Downloaded and archived bytes share a digest.
Capacity or hash failure never claims success.

suites.name: Typed Error Timeout Mapping
source_refs: document/資料庫、資料處理/新版驗證雙軌總計畫_草案.md
acceptance: Error envelopes contain category, retryability and correlation identity.
Conflicts require re-query or preview before retry.
Timeout queries receipts instead of resending commands.
